title: Insertion sort: score ordering
description: Implement insertion sort in sort_values(values). Return a new list of integers in ascending order without changing the input. Do not use sorted() or list.sort(). Explain the worst-case time complexity in a comment. Output tests cannot verify your algorithm choice; compare your approach with the solution.
hints: Divide the task into a small operation that you repeat.
Worst-case time: O(n²) for bubble, insertion and quicksort; O(n log n) for merge sort.
